During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[3681 BBY|3681]] and [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> a '''commander''' led a portion of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|armada]] in an effort to take the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Kilran" /> The commander was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of either [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent,<ref name="Species" /> and during the [[Battle of Ord Ibanna|battle]] over [[Ord Ibanna]], the Sith's fleet [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] took heavy losses and the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]]. In the aftermath of the commander's [[Death/Legends|death]], [[Rycus Kilran]], a non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] tactical advisor, took command of the fleet and led it to victory over the Republic.<ref name="Kilran" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith commander was first mentioned in Rycus Kilran's entry on [[The Holonet]], an online database of background information on the upcoming [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Kilran" />
